features.generation_history: hash-chained order metadata with content hashes
features.order_language: renders inside stored Commerce Suite order-language scope and preserves RTL/LTR direction
features.branding_templates: active customer profile with per-document/per-language template overrides
features.pdf: local Dompdf when installed or itk_commerce_documents_pdf_renderer integration
features.barcode_qr: local renderer integration through itk_commerce_document_code_markup with document-code fallback

notes: The renderer reads WooCommerce orders through WC_Order CRUD and does not modify commercial amounts, items or payment state.
Document numbers are assigned once and persisted separately from the WooCommerce order number.
PDF rendering is local/adapter-based and does not require a remote PDF service.
Jurisdiction-specific invoice wording, mandatory tax fields and final PDF output require Phase 0/8 target-environment approval before production sign-off.
WooCommerce minimum/tested ranges remain unset until Phase 0 environment audit data is recorded.
